name: Y2K Aesthetic
what_it_means: Y2K design channels the late-90s/early-2000s vision of the future: liquid chrome type, iridescent holographic gradients, glossy bubble buttons, sparkles, blobby shapes and translucent tech. It is shiny, optimistic and nostalgic for Gen-Z audiences.
signature_moves: Translucent windows and early-web UI nods
best_for: Fashion, beauty, music, Gen-Z apps, merch drops
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design a merch-drop landing page for [BRAND] in a Y2K aesthetic. Background: soft holographic iridescent gradient (pink #FF9DE2, baby blue #8FD3FF, lilac #C9B6FF). Headline in liquid chrome lettering (silver gradient fill, white highlights, dark outline, slight bevel). Glossy pill buttons with a white top highlight and inner glow. Decorate with 4-point sparkles ✦ , chrome blob shapes, a butterfly and a translucent early 2000s window panel with a title bar. Fonts: a wide futuristic display face (Michroma / Syne) plus a clean sans. Add gentle shimmer animations.
